description: The external artefacts this engine runs on, pinned by sha256. The weights under models/ (`models/*.gguf`) are gitignored — they do not live in the repository — so this file is the only record of WHICH bytes any measurement was taken on. It exists because a test failure could not be resolved without it: a set of goldens was recorded against an export whose hash nobody wrote down, and when the same file was re-fetched from the same repository a month later it reproduced 857 of 880. With no hash there is no way to tell a re-quantised upload from a broken port. Fetch and verify with `npm run models:fetch`.

artifacts.role: the rewrite and verifier model, served by llama-server

caveat: These are the bytes TODAY'S numbers were measured on. Any measurement taken against an unhashed artefact is not reproducible — that is the gap this file closes.
